name: telemetry-workbench
description: An OpenTelemetry and ClickHouse workbench for investigating production failures.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n dashboard,demo -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @telemetry-workbench/dashboard" "npm run dev -w @telemetry-workbench/demo-service"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @telemetry-workbench/dashboard && npm run build -w @telemetry-workbench/demo-service
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @telemetry-workbench/dashboard && npm run typecheck -w @telemetry-workbench/demo-service
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @telemetry-workbench/dashboard && npm run lint -w @telemetry-workbench/demo-service
scripts.infra:logs: docker compose -f infra/compose.yml logs -f otel-collector clickhouse
